header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: (AS) and upon his family, shower mercy upon Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ and upon the family of Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ! Indeed You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah! Just as You showered barakah upon Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) and upon his family, shower barakah upon Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ and upon his family! Indeed You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious — keep reciting this Salawat!” the Prophet ﷺ replied.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدِ نِ السَّاعِدِيِّ ﵁ أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ كَيْفَ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: قُولُوا اَللّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلي مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَي آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلي آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري كتاب احاديث الانبياء رقم:٣٣٦٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Humaid Sa'idi (RA) narrates that when the noble Sahabah asked, “Ya Rasulallah! How should we send Salawat upon you?”, the Prophet ﷺ said: “Keep reciting the Salawat (اَللّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلي مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَي آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلي مُحَمَّدٍ وَّأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلي آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ): O Allah! Just as You showered mercy upon the family of Hazrat Ibrahim (AS), shower mercy upon Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ and upon his wives and his descendants! And just as You showered barakah upon the family of Hazrat Ibrahim (AS), shower barakah upon Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ and upon his wives and his descendants! Indeed You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدنِ الخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قُلْنَا: يارَسُولَ اللهِ! هذَا
